description: Scatter Plume compares two measures at a glance: one point per product, customer or city, a third measure for bubble size and a Legend field for one color per series. Add a date to the Play axis and watch every bubble move through time. Free features, no watermark Play axis: play button, slider, loop, autoplay, trail of the selected bubbles. Zoom and select: zoom sliders, Shift + drag to zoom, rectangle or lasso selection, Ctrl to add. Large clouds: up to 100,000 points, drawn fast on a canvas; jitter separates identical points. Points and bubbles: shape per series, size scaling like Power BI, bubbles kept inside the plot. Labels: largest points, all or selected ones, without overlap; a Label field for one text per point. Axes: linear or logarithmic, min and max, inverted, titles, gridlines; dates shown with the column format; a Color field for one color per point. Interact: click a point or the legend to cross-filter, right-click menu, tooltips, keyboard navigation. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. For everyone: screen readers, high contrast, reduced motion, English and French. Premium features ★ Quadrants: splits at the average, median, a value or a target measure; names, four tints and point counts.
